questions.stem: A 3-year-old child arrives at the pediatric outpatient department in the morning with complaints of recurrent nosebleeds and noticeable fatigue. The mother also reports that the child has gingival hyperplasia. Following a complete blood count (CBC), the results reveal anemia, thrombocytopenia, and leukocytosis with 75% blast cells, leading to a diagnosis of acute myeloid leukemia (AML). Considering the specific symptom of gingival hyperplasia alongside the AML diagnosis, which subtype of AML is this child most likely to have?
